games:2026-wk13-usc-ucla.blurb: USC is a 7-point favorite on the road, but ESPN's model can't separate these rivals at all, giving UCLA a 51.2% edge in a game with a 45.5 total. The No. 10 Bruins are the Big Ten's current leader; the No. 15 Trojans are chasing from the bubble's back edge.

games:2026-wk13-arizona-state-arizona.blurb: No. 16 Arizona lays 7.5 at home in the rivalry game and carries a 78% win probability with the total up at 54.5. Arizona State arrives unranked but needs only one afternoon to wreck the Wildcats' resume.

games:2026-wk13-michigan-ohio-state.blurb: No. 25 Ohio State is a 10.5-point home favorite with an 89.2% win probability, and the 38.5 total says both sides expect a grinder. Michigan comes in unranked with nothing to lose in the rivalry.

games:2026-wk13-louisville-kentucky.blurb: No. 18 Louisville is a 2.5-point pick on the road at Kentucky, with ESPN giving the Cardinals a 64.4% shot in a game totaled at 55.5. A slip here costs Louisville real ground in the at-large picture.

games:2026-wk13-oklahoma-missouri.blurb: No. 24 Missouri is a 1.5-point home favorite over No. 19 Oklahoma, and ESPN splits it almost exactly down the middle at 50.3-49.6. With a 40.5 total, expect the loser's playoff case to take a heavy hit.

games:2026-wk13-florida-florida-state.blurb: No. 20 Florida goes to Tallahassee a 5.5-point favorite with a 65.7% win probability in a rivalry game totaled at 52.5. The Gators are climbing the poll and can't afford to hand that progress back to an unranked Florida State.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-baylor-houston.blurb: No. 17 Houston hosts Baylor as a 4.5-point favorite with a 59.4% win probability and a 55.5 total. The Cougars have been climbing and need to keep the Big 12 résumé clean.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-texas-texas-a-.blurb: No. 5 Texas is a 10.5-point favorite in College Station, with ESPN giving the Longhorns an 83.9% shot in a rivalry game totaled at just 39.5. Texas is chasing Georgia in the SEC race and can't afford a stumble.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-purdue-indiana.blurb: No. 12 Indiana is a 22.5-point home favorite over Purdue with a 94.9% win probability. The Hoosiers are the closest chaser in the Big Ten race, so style points are the only real question.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-nebraska-iowa.blurb: No. 13 Iowa lays 6 at home against Nebraska in a game totaled at 39.5, with ESPN giving the Hawkeyes a 58.6% edge. Iowa sits two spots outside the field, so this is a must-hold.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-auburn-alabama.blurb: No. 6 Alabama is a 16.5-point home favorite over Auburn with an 88.3% win probability. The Tide should be comfortable, but the Iron Bowl rarely cooperates with a number that big.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-cincinnati-byu.blurb: No. 11 BYU hosts Cincinnati as a 14-point favorite with an 88.1% win probability and a 56.5 total. The Cougars need a clean finish to stay in the Big 12 conversation.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-mississippi-st.blurb: No. 23 Ole Miss is a 19.5-point home favorite over Mississippi State, with ESPN pegging the Rebels at 87.6%. The 56.5 total suggests points won't be hard to come by in the Egg Bowl.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-tcu-texas-tech.blurb: No. 9 Texas Tech lays 12.5 at home against TCU with an 82.3% win probability. The Red Raiders are seven spots back of Utah in the Big 12 race and need help plus a win.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-washington-ore.blurb: No. 14 Oregon is a 13.5-point home favorite over Washington with an 87.4% win probability. The Ducks are three spots outside the field, so a comfortable win is the floor here.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-tennessee-vand.blurb: No. 7 Tennessee is a 12.5-point road favorite at Vanderbilt with an 87.7% win probability and a 43.5 total. Nothing fancy required, just no slip in a tight SEC pecking order.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-georgia-tech-g.blurb: No. 1 Georgia is a 35.5-point home favorite over Georgia Tech, with ESPN giving the Bulldogs a 98.3% win probability. Clean Old-Fashioned Hate projects as a formality on paper.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-west-virginia-.blurb: No. 2 Utah hosts West Virginia as a 20.5-point favorite with a 93.7% win probability and a hefty 69.5 total. The Utes lead the Big 12 by a comfortable seven spots over Texas Tech.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-boston-college.blurb: No. 4 Miami is a 25.5-point home favorite over Boston College with a 97.9% win probability. The Hurricanes lead the ACC race and should treat this as a tune-up.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-liberty-missou.blurb: No. 21 Liberty is a 14.5-point road favorite at Missouri State, with ESPN giving the Flames an 89.5% shot. A ranked team playing a game it's supposed to win comfortably.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-notre-dame-syr.blurb: No. 3 Notre Dame travels to Syracuse as a 26.5-point favorite with a 95.1% win probability. The Irish have far more to lose here than to gain.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-duke-wake-fore.blurb: No. 8 Wake Forest hosts Duke as a 14-point favorite with a 77.6% win probability and a 56.5 total. The Demon Deacons are chasing Miami in the ACC and need every week to count.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-boise-state-co.blurb: No. 22 Boise State is a 21-point road favorite at Colorado State, with ESPN giving the Broncos a 95.1% shot and the total set at a wild 74.5. Points should be everywhere in Fort Collins.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State tumbled from 14th to 25th in the poll, but the advanced numbers still love the Buckeyes: fourth in SP+ and sixth in FPI. That's as wide a gap between voters and models as you'll find in the Top 25.

predictions:houston.blurb: Houston climbed from 20th to 17th, though the metrics remain skeptical at 25th in SP+ and 29th in FPI. The résumé is outrunning the underlying profile.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA slid from fourth to 10th and still sits as the Big Ten's leader, with SP+ at 12th and FPI down at 22nd. The models have never been as sold as the poll was.

predictions:indiana.blurb: Indiana dropped from eighth to 12th despite ranking fifth in SP+ and eighth in FPI. The Hoosiers grade out as a better team than their new slot suggests.

predictions:florida.blurb: Florida moved up from 24th to 20th with FPI roughly on board at 21st, but SP+ is a holdout at 47th. That's a split worth watching in Tallahassee.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: The Big Ten's automatic bid is the tightest race on the board: No. 10 UCLA leads with No. 12 Indiana just two spots back. One bad Saturday flips it.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: No. 1 Georgia holds the SEC's auto bid with No. 5 Texas four spots behind. The Bulldogs control it, but the Longhorns are close enough to pounce.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-acc.blurb: No. 4 Miami owns the ACC lead with No. 8 Wake Forest four spots in arrears. The Demon Deacons need a Hurricanes slip to take it.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: Utah has the most comfortable perch of any league leader, sitting No. 2 with No. 9 Texas Tech seven spots back. The Big 12 bid is the Utes' to lose.

bubbleNotes:oregon.blurb: Oregon sits at the 15 seed, three spots outside the field and trending the wrong way after slipping one spot. The Ducks need results, not just wins.

bubbleNotes:indiana.blurb: Indiana is the first team out at No. 13, just one spot from the field, but the Hoosiers fell four places in the latest look. They're closest to in and moving backward at the same time.

bubbleNotes:usc.blurb: USC climbed three spots to the 16 seed, still four out of the field, and draws No. 10 UCLA next. Win that and the math changes in a hurry.

bubbleNotes:iowa.blurb: Iowa jumped two spots to the 14 seed and now sits two away from the field. The Hawkeyes are the bubble's hottest riser right now.
